overview: The Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee met to approve the draft May City Council newsletter and coordinate a schedule for neighborhood ward meetings at local schools for the fall of 2026.

items.title: City Council Newsletter
items.summary: Approved the May edition of the newsletter, which summarizes budget deliberations and adds a new section for city project highlights. The paper was kept in committee for future monthly drafts.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings Schedule
items.summary: The committee discussed a tentative schedule for ward meetings to be held at local schools from September through December 2026. Chair Mullane will confirm these dates with school officials and finish scheduling meetings for 2027.
